rows.en: (Today I came to see a movie with Ranka!)

that I couldn't fall asleep.
There you go lying again~!
I mean it!

Yeah, yeah...
Well then, let's go!
Man, that was a fun movie.

I was on the edge of my seat for all
120 minutes!
When it comes to movies, nothing beats action.
Uh-huh, uh-huh!
